items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: He never made to hear what these men made, you know? Joe was mostly local stuff. He never went anywhere in the way of speaking, you know?

ctx.x: Well, that's the difference altogether. He never made to hear what these men made, you know? Joe was mostly local stuff. He never went anywhere in the way of speaking, you know?
I just wondered if he played as loud as Bowden Joe.
Well, they could all play loud. Boy's blasting is concerned. All them guys could play loud. That was just tight, you know? Just hollow blow, that's all. What about fingering?
